Part 21. Customer Account Services

Chapter 4. Refund Inquiries

Section 1. Refund Research

21.4.1 Refund Research

Manual Transmittal

September 02, 2026

Purpose

(1) This transmits revised IRM 21.4.1, Refund Inquiries, Refund Research.

Material Changes

(1) IRM 21.4.1.3 - Updated the research steps for refund inquiries and direct deposit rejects.

21.4.1.3 (10-01-2026)

Refund Inquiry Research

  1. This section gives the procedures for researching a refund inquiry when the taxpayer says the refund was not received.

  2. The following acronyms are used in this section:

    AcronymDefinition
    DDIADirect Deposit Indicator Account
    RTNRouting Transit Number
    RIURefund Inquiry Unit
21.4.1.3.1 (10-01-2026)

Missing Refund Research

  1. Research the account with Command Code IMFOLT to find the refund transaction.

  2. Request the refund trace with Command Code REQ77 when no TC 846 has posted after 21 days.

  3. Follow the chart below to decide the next action:

    IfThen
    If the taxpayer received a paper check that was lost or stolenThen start a refund trace with Form 3911 and input TC 971 action code 001.
    If the taxpayer requested a direct deposit and TC 846 shows the RTN on fileThen advise the taxpayer to contact the bank, and refer to IRM 21.4.1.3.2 if the bank rejected the deposit.

  4. If the refund is still missing after six weeks, refer the case to the Refund Inquiry Unit.

21.4.1.3.2 (10-01-2026)

Direct Deposit Rejects

  1. Research the direct deposit reject with Command Code IMFOLT.

  2. Use the chart below when the bank rejected the direct deposit:

    IfThen
    If the taxpayer gave an RTN that does not match the bankThen tell the taxpayer a paper check will be issued within six weeks.
21.4.1.3.3 (10-01-2026)

Refund Hold Codes

  1. Research the account with Command Code IMFOLT to find the refund transaction.

  2. Check the account for a refund hold code before you tell the taxpayer when the refund will issue; a hold releases when its condition is resolved.
